name: Archer
source:
The servant of [url=/c3535]Dan Blackmore[/url]. He fights using ambushes, much to the chagrin of his morally strict master.

[spoiler]His true identity is Robin Hood. His Noble Phantasm is the Yew Bow.[/spoiler]
